title: The Postcards of the coast road
author: Edmund Vane
blurb: Wren Zhou, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
